The scatter plot for the data sets $x$ and $y$ of paired observations and the corresponding linear regression line are shown above.

According to the regression model, what is the residual for the highlighted datapoint?
question.worked_solution:
The residual equals the difference between the actual value of the dependent variable and the value estimated using the linear regression model:

$$
\text{Residual}=\text{Actual}-\text{Estimated}
$$

 

The highlighted datapoint has coordinates $(10,4).$ So, our actual value is $y=4.$

On the other hand, the point on the regression line that corresponds to $x=10$ has the $y$-coordinate $8.$ So, our estimated value of is $\overset{^}{y}=8.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14212614/assets/61ed1ba4b285ac0d21410ddde91c3ed3882def52cbc500867aa7184114dd8fd8.png)

Therefore, the residual is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Residual} & =\text{Actual}-\text{Estimated} \\  & =y-\overset{^}{y} \\  & =4-8 \\  & =-4.\end{aligned}
$$
